guidance_sources.title: ICAR Kharif Agro-Advisory for Farmers 2025
guidance_sources.guidance: Maize water is especially important at pre-tasseling, silking, and grain filling when rain is absent; rice guidance includes irrigation at panicle initiation and flowering; cotton guidance emphasizes avoiding water stress during flowering and fruiting and avoiding early water stagnation.

threshold_note: Recent-rain and heat cutoffs are configurable prototype triggers for field-moisture checks. They are not ICAR-prescribed irrigation amounts or schedules.
